fixed.summary: `og new --genre interactive-film` (or `--form film`, or the prompt's form `film`) makes an interactive film: the create block records `form "film"` and `genre "interactive-film"` instead of action-platformer, and the skeleton adds the picture's film-view screen and a src/main.ts that shows the film with the built-in subtitles and film-choices screens. The start guide points to the film guide.
§8 gives the snapshot round trip inside a choice window as one command whose restore keeps the run on the same ticks, so its hash compares with the uninterrupted run's.
